messages:
maria: morning — noticed a sudden pileup of small GPU jobs in eu-west1, pending count jumped at 06:10 UTC
kevin: same, fast-provision pool target stayed same but Ready slots dropped ~40
ashley: any provisioning errors showing?
maria: reconciler logs full of lease TTL expirations and heartbeat_mismatch starting 06:12
leo: looks like mixed agent versions; 2.5.0 introduced heartbeat_epoch, older fleet-agent treats missing field as invalid
sre-bot: ALERT: region=eu-west1 condition=provisioner_rate>0.2 pending_gpu>50
kevin: mitigation plan?
ashley: short: increase lease TTL and run a manual sweep to claim orphaned slots. medium: add backward-compat fallback for heartbeat parser. long: add integration test for heartbeat schema migration
maria: bumped TTL from 30s -> 90s via configmap patch and kicked off sweep script; reclaimed ~25 slots, pending dropped by ~20
leo: opened PR for parser fallback (https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/412) and will canary 2.5.1 to 10% in eu-west1a
kevin: rollback plan if canary fails: disable autopromote and helm rollback to 2.4.x image
maria: note: scaled fast-provision pool +20 for headroom (finance ok)
ashley: postmortem action items: metric heartbeat_schema_mismatch_total, alert + runbook pointing to sweep tool, migration test coverage
leo: also observed slight bump in egress retries same window, tracking separately
maria: proceeding with canary, monitoring lease_error_rate and slot_ready_latency; will update thread when stable or if revert needed :rocket:
